sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying any transformation to Nothing still yields Nothing
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to give someone who is absent, the result is still absence.
sketches.draft:
gift :: a -> Maybe b -> Maybe a
gift _ Nothing  = Nothing
gift x (Just _) = Just x

result = gift <$> Nothing

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference automatically becomes nil when the referenced object is deallocated — the language zeroes out what you held
sketches.resonance: You held onto someone, but the language of time made your grip dissolve to nil without warning or ceremony.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function typed as returning 'never' is one that can never successfully complete
sketches.resonance: Some promises are made in a form that the type system itself guarantees can never be fulfilled.
